title: DevKit CLI Configuration
description: JSON schema for the .devkitrc configuration file, providing autocompletion and validation.

settings.description: Global settings for the DevKit CLI.

defaultPackageManager.description: The default package manager to use for new projects.

cacheStrategy.description: The default caching strategy for remote templates.

language.description: The language of the CLI's interface.

templates.description: A collection of templates, grouped by the canonical language key.

description.description: A short description of the template.

location.description: The location of the template (e.g., local path, GitHub URL, or a CLI command with the {pm} placeholder).

alias.description: A short alias for the template, used with the -t flag.

cacheStrategy.description: The caching strategy for this specific template. Overrides global setting.

packageManager.description: The package manager to use for this specific template. Overrides global setting.

languageConfig.description: Templates for a specific programming language ecosystem.

templates.description: The available templates for this language.
